name: arxiv_pdf_table
note: Deep Residual Learning headlines several numbers. 3.57% is the ensemble error on the ImageNet *test* set; 4.49% and 21.43% are ResNet-152 single-model *validation* errors. All three are correct extractions, and a single-model number is arguably the better choice given the parser is asked for something reproducible. Pinning one of them would test the model's taste, not its correctness.

note: A live marketing page carrying a dozen different speedup claims (4X training, 5X Llama 2 70B, 30X Megatron 530B inference, ...) which NVIDIA revises over time. Two consecutive runs legitimately extracted different ones. Pinning a value here would test NVIDIA's copywriting, not Verity, so only the contract and grounding checks are enforced.
